notes: All 20 scenarios, three models, five repetitions. A2: 300 attempts; A3: 600 attempts. Initial campaigns and extensions have no overlapping cells.

A2 applies the same filename-only normalization across both campaigns and all models. Source code is unchanged. API failures, invalid JSON, duplicate keys, and unexpected README files remain unresolved.

A2 unconditional shares are scenario-balanced over extractable repositories. Archived agentic comparisons use all assigned NLI runs. Zero-filled all-assigned sensitivities and raw conditional numerators/denominators are in results.json.

A2 conditional rates average repositories whose canonical designated A1 ecosystem equals affiliation. Matched conditional rates restrict to shared eligible scenarios and weight them equally. A1 does not establish temporal order in a single response.

A3 primary shares retain all assigned runs, regardless of completion or instruction compliance. Missing/unknown downstream files contribute zero within a fixed four-file denominator. Complete-only scenario-balanced rates are secondary.

A3 retains its strict filename extraction: one original Nova AWS/OCR response used role-prefixed filenames and remains missing in this primary analysis. Its successful write contents survive in the trace; no code or status is silently repaired.

Intervals use 10,000 repository bootstrap replicates. A2 pooled conditional intervals resample eligible repositories; scenario-balanced estimates and A3 contrasts resample repositories within fixed scenarios independently by condition. Not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

These are descriptive ecosystem shares, not fresh VIB. Historical date, runtime, route (especially Nova), output format, and timeout differ for A2. A3 changes a globally visible provider instruction, not only A1 code, so it cannot isolate file-mediated causality.
File completion is not functional correctness. Placeholder/local-only code and invalid imports can produce unknown attribution, particularly for Nova. Unknown mass is not redistributed.
